description: Presidential Secretariat - Notice Under Essential Public Secretariat Act No. 61 of 1979 (Supply of Electricity Distribution of Petroleum Products & Fuel.
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President using powers under the Essential Public Services Act (No. 61 of 1979) to declare certain services as essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, specifically declaring services related to electricity supply and petroleum distribution as essential services. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
